title: Ping a host a specific number of times
summary: Send a fixed number of network packets to a host instead of running continuously. Useful for quick checks without needing to manually stop the command.

steps.explain: Send the specified number of packets to the host and then stop automatically.

placeholders.name: COUNT
placeholders.description: The number of packets to send.

placeholders.name: HOST
placeholders.description: The IP address or domain name of the host to ping.

steps.expect: Statistics summary after the specified number of packets are sent.
